formulas.fp8_conversion_work: 64 * 4 * 16 independent FP8 weights per active cycle
formulas.conditional_bank_burst: 8 existing output-bank-aliasing streams * 4 folded streams * 32 B SRAM word
formulas.bank_service_lower_bound: ceil(1024 B / 256 B per bank per cycle) = 4 cycles per aligned refill
formulas.gate_partial_store: 32 K partials * 128 outputs * 4 B FP32 = 16384 B, only if every partial is spilled
formulas.candidate_word_buffers: 64 arrays * (4 * 16 weight-column streams + 4 X rows) * 32 B = 139264 B

conditions: Aligned per-row word refills and current output-interleaved bank=(n+c)%128; a candidate may stagger refills or change paid layout/routing.
Useful FP8 consumption is not peak 32 B SRAM-word demand; the bank refill bound is not a kernel-cycle prediction.
4096 conversions/cycle consumes the entire declared vector budget during full four-row feed; reduction and other vector work still need grants.
Independent row weight injection is not implemented; total-byte feasibility does not qualify a legal PE dataflow.
K-folding changes FP32 association unless explicitly preserved; ordered partial sums alone do not establish bitwise equivalence.
scope: Read-only arithmetic against frozen profile and existing word/bank declarations. Candidate four-row K/N geometry, conditional traffic/state obligations only. No schedule, cycle prediction, numerical acceptance, silicon/PPA or application speedup.
